content.text:
I implemented `slugify(text)` in `src/strings.js` and added 8 tests for it in `test/strings.test.js`. `npm test` passes: 10 of 10, including the 2 existing `capitalize` tests.

It handles đ/Đ first, then strips diacritics, lowercases, and turns each run of non-`a-z0-9` characters into one hyphen. It trims hyphens at both ends, cuts to 50 characters, and removes any hyphen left at the cut.

The tests cover:
- basic lowercasing and hyphenation
- Vietnamese text, including đ
- other Latin diacritics
- collapsing runs of symbols
- trimming hyphens at both ends
- empty and symbol-only input
- the 50-character limit
- a cut that would land on a hyphen

Non-string input is converted with `String(text)`, so `slugify(null)` returns `'null'`. You didn't specify this case, so say if you'd rather it throw or return an empty string.
